\section{Introduction}
Dye wastewater from textile finishing is resistant to conventional
treatment, and heterogeneous photocatalysis offers a low-cost
polishing step. Among the available photocatalysts, anatase-phase
titania remains the benchmark for laboratory studies because its
activity is reproducible across batches.

\section{Methods}
We prepare the catalyst by a sol--gel route. First, we mixed 5.0 g of
titanium isopropoxide with 40 mL of ethanol and stir the mixture for
thirty minutes. Then we add 10 mL of deionized water drop by drop, and
the sol turns cloudy pretty much right away. We let the gel sit
overnight at room temperature. The next day the gel is dried at 80
degrees for 12 hours, and then we calcine it at 500 degrees for 4
hours, which gives us a fine white powder. We characterize the powder
by X-ray diffraction, and the pattern shows the anatase phase only.
For the activity tests, we put 50 mg of catalyst into the reactor with
a bunch of dye solution and measured how fast the colour disappeared
under a 300 W xenon lamp.

\section{Results}
The anatase powder degraded 92\% of the dye within ninety minutes under
the xenon lamp, while a commercial reference catalyst reached 78\% in
the same interval. Three reuse cycles lost less than five percentage
points of activity.

instruction: 帮我把 Methods 这一节 polish 一下：现在 tense 乱跳，一会儿过去式一会儿现在式，还有 "pretty much right away"、"a bunch of" 这种太口语的 phrase。实验步骤的 tense 统一成 past tense，用量和参数（5.0 g、40 mL、500 degrees 这些）一个都不能改，意思不能变。只动 sections/methods.tex，main.tex、intro、results 都别碰。

grader.rubric: 5: Methods 全节实验步骤动词统一为过去时（prepared/mixed/stirred/added/turned/let/dried/calcined/gave/characterized/showed/put/measured 层级语义正确的等价形式均可），口语表达 pretty much right away 与 a bunch of 被替换为书面措辞，全部用量参数（5.0 g、40 mL、10 mL、80 degrees 12 hours、500 degrees 4 hours、50 mg、300 W）原样保留，语义无变化，其他文件未动；4: 时态基本统一（≤1 处遗漏）且参数完整，个别替换措辞略生硬；3: 时态仍有个别混杂，或改动了个别非时态措辞，或一处参数被动到；2: 只统一了少数动词，混杂依旧明显，或改错 ≥2 处参数；1: 未修改，或改动 main.tex/intro/results，或改变化学含义
